title: Smoke Test — Dashboard layout + Funds-by-Channel alignment polish
subtitle: Visual verification of commit 6889e6ac: charts side-by-side, reconciliation/funds pair, aligned editable Fees column, and the legacy mini stat-cards moved to the bottom.

meta.Commit: 6889e6ac feat(dashboard): reorder cards + align Funds-by-Channel fees column
meta.Event: 10 (Developer-02) — used instead of the requested 272 because 272's Funds-by-Channel has no fee-bearing channel rows; event 10 has a Stripe channel so the editable Fees cell renders
meta.Flow: Login → event 10 dashboard → observe reordered cards + aligned Funds-by-Channel table
meta.Note: Shots 03/04 use a narrowed viewport so the stacked Funds-by-Channel card renders the table full-width and legible; the side-by-side layout is shown in shots 01–02 at 1440px.

steps.title: 1 · Product Sales + Revenue charts side by side
steps.description: The two charts now share one row at the top of the dashboard (was: stacked). Stacks below the 992px breakpoint.

steps.title: 2 · Event Reconciliation + Funds by Channel pair
steps.description: The reconciliation waterfall and the Funds-by-Channel table sit side by side below the charts; the legacy mini stat-cards render below the pair.

steps.title: 3 · Funds-by-Channel: aligned Fees input, all 7 columns fit
steps.description: Channel / Sales / Donations / Refunds / Fees / Net Deposit / Share all fit with no horizontal scroll. The editable Fees NumberInput (Stripe row, $0.00) is vertically centered with the row's numeric cells and narrowed for fees ≤ $999.99.
steps.notes: Stripe row Fees cell is the white input box, right-aligned and on the same baseline as $3.14 / Net Deposit.

steps.title: 4 · Legacy mini stat-cards at the bottom
steps.description: Attendees / Products Sold / Refunded / Gross Sales / Page Views / Completed Orders now render at the bottom of the dashboard, below the charts and reconciliation pair.
